# Ra.One: Summary
"Ra.One" is a 2011 Indian science-fiction action film produced by Shah Rukh Khan’s Red Chillies Entertainment and directed by Anubhav Sinha. The plot centers on Shekhar Subramaniam, who creates a video game with a near-invincible antagonist, Ra.One, endowed with self-learning AI. When Ra.One escapes the game and enters the real world, he relentlessly pursues Shekhar's son, Prateek (Lucifer), resulting in Shekhar’s death. To protect Prateek and combat Ra.One, the game's protagonist G.One, modeled after Shekhar, is also brought into reality. The narrative unfolds across London and Mumbai, culminating in an action-packed showdown where Ra.One is destroyed and G.One returns to the digital world, only to be revived by Prateek later.
The film stars Shah Rukh Khan (Shekhar/G.One), Kareena Kapoor (Sonia), Arjun Rampal (Ra.One), and Armaan Verma (Prateek), with notable cameos from Rajinikanth (as Chitti from Enthiran) and Amitabh Bachchan (voiceover). Ra.One was distinguished by its groundbreaking use of visual effects, extensive international marketing, and release across more than 4,000 screens. It achieved major box office success, setting pre-release revenue and opening day records, though its overall critical reception was mixed. Praise focused on its technical achievements and action scenes, while criticism addressed its plot, direction, and originality amid plagiarism allegations. Ra.One won multiple awards for visual effects and spawned related media, with early discussions about a potential sequel.
